topic: The real cost of forgotten subscriptions
hook: That fifteen dollar subscription you forgot about could cost you around eighteen thousand dollars.

blocks.narration: That fifteen dollar subscription you forgot about could cost you around eighteen thousand dollars. Here is exactly how that happens.
blocks.visual: A tiny clay streaming remote sits on a couch, a faint trail of coins leaking from it

blocks.narration: Fifteen dollars a month does not feel like much. It is about the price of lunch, so it slips past your attention.
blocks.visual: A clay wallet opens and a single coin slips out each month as calendar pages flip

blocks.narration: But over thirty years, that is five thousand four hundred dollars in payments for something you might not even use.
blocks.visual: The leaking coins pile up into a surprisingly large mound on the floor

blocks.narration: Now imagine investing that same fifteen dollars a month instead, earning a hypothetical seven percent average yearly return over time.
blocks.visual: The coins reverse direction and flow into a glass jar with a small sprout in it

blocks.narration: After thirty years, it could grow to roughly eighteen thousand three hundred dollars, more than three times what you paid in.
blocks.visual: The sprout grows into a tree with gold coins as leaves, filling the frame

blocks.narration: Most people have several of these. Apps, trials that rolled over, memberships, cloud storage you upgraded once and forgot.
blocks.visual: Five small clay icons line up, each with its own thin stream of leaking coins

blocks.narration: Once a quarter, scroll your bank and card statements for recurring charges. Cancel anything you would not sign up for again today.
blocks.visual: A clay hand with scissors snips the coin streams one by one

blocks.narration: Small leaks sink big ships. Open your bank app tonight, find one to cancel, and comment what you found.
blocks.visual: The coin tree glows brighter as the last stream is cut, camera pulls back

cta: Open your bank app tonight and find one to cancel. Comment what you found.

captions.hook_line: That forgotten $15 subscription could cost you $18,000 🫠
captions.body: $15 a month is $5,400 over 30 years. Invested at a hypothetical 7% average return instead, it could grow to about $18,300. Audit recurring charges once a quarter.
